gaps.title: Production billing service factory composition
gaps.detail: api/v1 app contracts are registered, but the production runtime composition still needs to attach a request-scoped PostgresBillingServiceFactory and managed payment provider configuration.

gaps.title: Generation and tool runtimes must enforce credit reservation/consume
gaps.detail: BillingService exposes versioned usage pricing and atomic consume, but generation/tool gateways are not yet wired to preflight credits before expensive work.

gaps.title: Live PostgreSQL concurrent-consume race test
gaps.detail: Repository uses SELECT FOR UPDATE and a unique operation key, but a two-connection race test must execute in CI before declaring production-safe concurrency.

gaps.title: Real payment provider adapter
gaps.detail: Intentionally deferred until sandbox acceptance; MockPaymentProvider is the only provider implemented in NODE-63 core.

gaps.title: Plan catalog mutation/admin UX and seat billing
gaps.detail: Immutable plan-version storage exists, but admin catalog creation/migration and seat billing remain for Admin Console/commercial rollout.

gaps.title: Tax and jurisdiction-specific invoice policy
gaps.detail: No tax rates are hard-coded. Production tax/invoice policy remains delegated to the selected provider and legal/accounting validation.

gaps.title: Hosted CI execution evidence
gaps.detail: NODE-63 cannot be COMPLETE until compile, tests, migration checks, lint/typecheck and web build execute on a hosted runner.

gaps.title: Provider cost is separated from customer billing
gaps.detail: Billing reconciliation reads NODE-27 cost_ledger without mutating or redefining provider-cost truth.

gaps.title: Credit history is immutable
gaps.detail: billing_credit_ledger is append-only with a database trigger rejecting UPDATE/DELETE and unique organization operation IDs.

gaps.title: Webhook idempotency and payload conflict fence
gaps.detail: provider/event IDs are unique and body SHA-256 is persisted; deterministic credit grant operation IDs prevent duplicate grants.

gaps.title: No card data through LUMI business API
gaps.detail: Mock hosted checkout/portal flows are used and mock webhook normalization rejects PAN/CVC-style fields.

gaps.title: Entitlements are plan-version snapshots
gaps.detail: EntitlementService projection reads immutable PlanVersion entitlements and normalized subscription state rather than plan-name conditionals.
